mentions.name: Meitian (tarot reading app)
mentions.description: A tarot reading app called Meitian whose free tarot reading feature has attracted 2,000 users; the builder is exploring which paid product features would convert those free users into paying customers.
mentions.problem: Unsure how to monetize — which paid features users would actually be willing to pay for — while converting the 2,000 free users into customers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m still trying to figure out how to convert “Meitian’s” 2,000 users into my own customers. Currently, the free tarot reading feature I offer has been very well-received, but I’m still unsure how to provide product features that would make users more willing to pay.

evidence.value: I’m still trying to figure out how to convert “Meitian’s” 2,000 users into my own customers. Currently, the free tarot reading feature I offer has been very well-received, but I’m still unsure how to provide product features that would make users more willing to pay.
